Prompts

```
['build an HRViT backbone model with multi-branch hierarchical architecture for semantic segmentation', 'create a cross-shaped window attention module with horizontal and vertical attention branches', 'build an HRViT transformer block combining attention, DES shortcut, and MixCFN feed-forward network', 'create a multi-scale feature fusion block that merges features across multiple resolution branches', 'build a mixed kernel convolution layer that splits channels between 3x3 and 5x5 convolutions']

```
